title: Define Drizzle ORM Schema and Migration for API Keys
description: Create a new `apiKeys` table in the Drizzle ORM schema, linking it to the `users` table. Generate and apply the migration to update the database.
details:
- Add a new `apiKeys` table in `db/schema.ts` (or equivalent), including columns: id (PK), userId (FK), name (string), hashedKey (string), createdAt, revokedAt (nullable), and optional scopes (JSONB).
- Ensure a foreign key constraint to the `users` table.
- Use Drizzle CLI to generate and apply the migration.
- Coordinate with deployment to ensure migrations are run before code relying on the new table is deployed.
test_strategy:
- Verify the migration applies cleanly on a fresh database and on an existing one.
- Check that the table structure matches the schema (columns, types, constraints).
- Test inserting and querying dummy data via Drizzle ORM in a local/dev environment.

title: Implement Secure API Endpoints for API Key Management
description: Develop Next.js API route handlers for creating, listing, and revoking API keys. Secure all endpoints using Better Auth and ensure only authenticated users can manage their own keys.
details:
- In `app/api/keys/route.ts`, implement:
  - POST: Generate a cryptographically secure API key, hash it (e.g., bcrypt), store the hash, and return the raw key once.
  - GET: List all API keys for the authenticated user (do not return raw keys, only metadata).
- In `app/api/keys/[keyId]/route.ts`, implement:
  - DELETE: Revoke (soft-delete) the specified key if it belongs to the authenticated user.
- Use Better Auth to authenticate and authorize all requests.
- Never store or return raw API keys except immediately after creation.
test_strategy:
- Unit test key generation and hashing logic.
- Integration test endpoints: ensure only authenticated users can access, keys are created/listed/revoked as expected, and raw keys are only returned once.
- Attempt unauthorized access and verify proper error responses.

title: Develop API Key Management UI in Dashboard
description: Build a new React client component for API key management using shadcn/ui components and integrate it into the dashboard. Allow users to view, create, and revoke their API keys.
details:
- Create `components/api-key-manager.tsx` as the main UI component.
- Use shadcn/ui Tabs for navigation (if needed), Table to list keys, Button to open a Dialog for key creation, and Dialog for displaying the new key (with a warning that it will not be shown again).
- Integrate the component into `app/dashboard/page.tsx`.
- Use lucide-react for icons (e.g., key icon).
- Handle client-side state for key creation and revocation, updating the list accordingly.
test_strategy:
- Manual and integration testing: log in, navigate to dashboard, create a key, verify it appears in the list, revoke a key, and check UI updates.
- Ensure the new key is only shown once and not retrievable after creation.
- Test accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA roles) and responsive design.

title: Ensure Route and API Protection with Better Auth Middleware
description: Verify and, if necessary, update middleware to ensure all new API key management endpoints and dashboard UI are protected and accessible only to authenticated users.
details:
- Review `middleware.ts` and API route handlers to confirm all new endpoints (`/api/keys/*`) are covered by Better Auth protection.
- Add or update middleware logic as needed to prevent unauthenticated access to API key management features.
- Ensure proper error handling and redirection for unauthorized requests.
test_strategy:
- Attempt to access API endpoints and dashboard UI as an unauthenticated user and verify redirection or error responses.
- Confirm authenticated users can access and use all features as expected.
